title: Ready, episode 5: the phone in the bedroom
needs: s11 reshoot: she must read as sixteen
Check the kid-deal crop shows where devices sleep
DiGi's plan is its own scenario EB-02 (digi/06-scenarios.md); run it as an eval case against live DiGi before finals

beats.quote: I don't want that phone in her bedroom all night.

beats.me: She gets her first phone next month. Where should it charge?

digi: Before it arrives: agree together that phones charge in the kitchen overnight.
If she needs an alarm: buy her an alarm clock. That solves the alarm.
Every night: yours charges there too. It is about sleep, not trust.

beats.line: Her first phone. The deal comes first.
Phone on the charger first. Then screens.
Her phone sleeps in the kitchen. Her choice.
